_about: SPARE deploy config — Robinhood Chain MAINNET (4663). Read by script/Deploy.s.sol and script/VerifyDeployment.s.sol. Addresses verified on-chain 2026-09-29 (see docs/SPARE-BUILD.md). Units: USDG 6 dp, stock tokens 18 dp, bps 10000 = 100%.
_roles: Launch roles (2026-09-29). owner = dedicated SPARE deployer EOA (DEPLOYER_PK in contracts/.env), also pauser + attestor; keeper = the engine hot key (KEEPER_PK). Owner is an EOA by the owner's decision; move to a multisig with transferOwnership + acceptOwnership when there is one.

screening._about: OFF at launch by the owner's decision. ScreeningGate is deployed with the attestor wired; flip with setEnforced(true).

router._sequencerFeed: No L2 sequencer-uptime feed is published for RHC (2026-09-29). address(0) = check skipped; set it with StockRouter.setSequencerFeed once one exists.

park._about: Launch park adapter is ALWAYS UsdgParkAdapter (no yield, no market dependency). The SGOV adapter is deployed and pre-authorised as a StockRouter caller but NOT set on CashPark; switching is an owner decision (docs/RUNBOOK.md, 'Switching to the SGOV adapter').

_assets_about: Venue allowlist: every asset is pinned to ONE exact v4 PoolKey, hook included. currency0 < currency1 (v4 sort order); one side is always USDG. Universe = every catalog asset with a Chainlink feed (36 of 203 tokenized stocks/ETFs on RHC, from a 2026-10 scan of the chain's token catalog and Chainlink's feed directory; the scan's working files are not in the repository). 'measured' = ACTUAL StockRouter.buy fills on an anvil fork of mainnet block 77853601 (2026-10-02): as the fork deployment's owner setAsset(..., 150, key) + setActive(true), then buy as SweepExecutor (tx.origin = keeper), $5 and $100 each from the same state, vs the router's own Chainlink price. Sign: negative = fewer tokens than the oracle price buys (older 'measured_prev' notes used + for a worse fill). Active = both fills >= -1.2%; HOOKLESS pools preferred (NVDA lesson). Apply with script/AddAssets.s.sol (idempotent). Hooked pools also pin their hook: hookCodehash (keccak256 of its runtime code), hookAuthority (the account its fee setters answer to) and hookMaxFeePips (the highest fee, in pips of 1e6, the keeper swaps through; below the band), plus hookFeeCap (the pool cap, maxFee, the keeper and the monitor expect: above it they hold or alert; engine/src/keeper/hooks.ts carries the same values, and the scripts do not read it). Deploy and AddAssets refuse, and VerifyDeployment fails, when the live hook differs, has a *_RETURNS_DELTA permission, or the ceiling is not inside the band; they also require token decimals 18 and heartbeat <= 26 h for every asset.

assets._watch: HOOKED pool (no hookless pool clears the bar; best hookless 2120/42 is -2.7% at $100). Hook 0x08E52564... is FablesRamp: Sourcify-verified, not a proxy, code pinned by hookCodehash. Flags 0x2080 = beforeInitialize + beforeSwap, no return-delta: it can set the fee or revert, never move amounts. The code cannot change; the OPERATOR's fee settings can, with no delay, through the same AccessManager 0xA362D98B... as MU's hook (hookAuthority): its ADMIN_ROLE (one account, execution delay 0) can setPoolConfig (flat fee, poke floor and cap, the cap up to the hook's ABSOLUTE_MAX_FEE of 50000 pips, 5%) or setPoolAsymmetry at once; its three FEE_POKER accounts (delay 0) can pokeFee up to the pool cap for up to 72 h, renewable. Read 2026-10-02, block 78503568: flat fee 500 pips (0.05%), poke floor 300, pool cap 20000 pips (2%), no live poke. hookMaxFeePips 500 (0.05%) is the flat fee: any poke or reconfiguration above it holds GME. Whatever the fee, StockRouter's 150 bps band turns a spike into a deferred leg, never a fill outside the band: the hook's fee on a buy is at most the ceiling, and beyond it the risk is liveness only. Re-run the fork check before relying on it at size.
